suppho

suppho.Rd

suppho created from scratch

Usage

suppho

Format

A data frame with 5955 rows and 8 variables:

STUDYID

Study Identifier

RDOMAIN

Related Domain

USUBJID

Unique Subject Identifier

IDVAR

Identifying Variable

IDVARVAL

Identifying Variable Value

QNAM

Qualifier Variable Name

QLABEL

Qualifier Variable Label

QVAL

Qualifier Value

See also

ae ds dv ho ie mh suppho ts

Examples

head(data("suppho"))
#> [1] "suppho"
